_note: Real-world intervention names for the cardio dataset's mutable features, cited against the SAME guideline registry src/graph/neurosymbolic.py already uses ([PCE2013], [HTN2017], [ADA2023], [CHOL2018]). Named intervention CATEGORIES from established clinical guidance, not fabricated numbers -- same convention as configs/interventions.json.

weight.name: Structured weight-management program
weight.description: A combined dietary-calorie-reduction and physical-activity program aimed at gradual, sustained weight loss.

ap_hi.name: DASH diet + sodium restriction
ap_hi.description: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) eating pattern and reduced dietary sodium, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for lowering systolic blood pressure.

ap_lo.name: DASH diet + sodium restriction
ap_lo.description: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) eating pattern and reduced dietary sodium, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for lowering diastolic blood pressure.

cholesterol.name: Statin therapy + reduced dietary saturated fat
cholesterol.description: Lipid-lowering pharmacotherapy (statins) combined with reduced saturated/trans fat intake, the guideline's core approach to lowering cholesterol.

gluc.name: Glycemic control program (diet, exercise, medication adherence)
gluc.description: Combined lifestyle and pharmacologic management of blood glucose aimed at lowering glucose toward guideline targets.

smoke.name: Smoking cessation program
smoke.description: Behavioral counseling combined with pharmacotherapy (e.g. nicotine replacement) for smoking cessation, standard guideline-directed risk-reduction advice.

alco.name: Alcohol-reduction counseling
alco.description: Brief behavioral counseling aimed at reducing heavy alcohol consumption, a standard guideline-directed lifestyle risk-reduction measure.

active.name: Supervised physical activity program
active.description: A structured program to increase regular physical activity, the guideline's first-line lifestyle intervention for cardiovascular risk reduction.
